تمنطقتن (form IIq)
# تَمَنْطَقْتُنَّ (tamanṭaqtunna) /ta.man.tˤaq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# تُمُنْطِقْتُنَّ (tumunṭiqtunna) /tu.mun.tˤiq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
